t: A card drawing game where student groups act as the parts of a GAN.
steps: Find the GANs Unplugged paper by Patrick Virtue in the AAAI-21 proceedings.
Read the activity description. The research team could not read the full procedure.
Prepare index cards for each group.
Write secret drawing instructions for the Real group.
Split the class into Real, Generator, and Discriminator groups.
Run a first round of sketching and guessing.
Run more rounds so the Generator can adapt to the feedback marks.
